about_the_game:
Support Kaiserpunk and enhance your experience with a variety of exclusive visual additions! This DLC only contains cosmetic items and offers a collection of unique aesthetical enhancements:
  • 10 Flag Patterns & 10 Flag Emblems – Expand your customization options with new designs to represent your city-state.
  • Exclusive Heritage – A special visual set for all army units, usable with any heritage from the base game.
  • A Unique Buildable Park – A decorative landmark to enrich your city’s aesthetics.
  • Custom Transporter Model – Replaces the standard transport truck with a distinctive new model.
  • The Very Goodest Boy – Swap out the default German Shepherd for a loyal Pug.
This pack is for players who want to add extra flair to their game while further supporting Kaiserpunk.
